title: CNCGEN: A Dataset and Framework for Machining Process Planning and Toolpath Generation from B-rep Models
abstract: arXiv:2609.39738v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Learning to generate machining process plans and toolpaths from B-rep CAD requires coupling discrete operation decisions with continuous tool motion as the workpiece evolves. Correctly predicting an operation sequence does not by itself ensure correct material removal, because each toolpath acts on the stock left by preceding cuts. We formulate this problem around persistent manufacturing objects: object identity determines the target of an operation, while the evolving stock state conditions the generation of its toolpath. Based on this formulation, we propose CNCGEN, a dataset and learning framework for three-axis machining. CNCGEN-Dataset contains approximately 50k geometrically verified synthetic machining flows and 800 held-out real CNC records. translated_title: CNCGEN：基于B-rep模型的加工工艺规划与刀具路径生成数据集与框架
translated_abstract: 从B-rep CAD模型中学习生成加工工艺规划与刀具路径，需要将离散的工序决策与连续的刀具运动耦合起来，且工件处于不断演变之中。仅正确预测工序序列本身并不能保证正确的材料去除，因为每条刀具路径都作用于前序切削后留下的毛坯。我们围绕持久性制造对象来构建该问题：对象身份决定工序的作用目标，而不断演变的毛坯状态则约束其刀具路径的生成。基于这一表述，我们提出了CNCGEN，一个面向三轴加工的数据集与学习框架。CNCGEN数据集包含约5万个经过几何验证的合成加工流程以及800条留出的真实CNC记录。每个流程将B-rep几何与引用对象的工序、参数化刀具路径、中间毛坯状态以及验证结果对齐，从而能够对两者之间的对应关系进行监督（摘要原文在此处截断）。
tldr: 该论文提出了围绕持久性制造对象构建的CNCGEN数据集与学习框架，将离散工序决策与受不断演变的毛坯状态约束的连续刀具路径生成相耦合，为三轴加工的工艺规划与刀具路径生成提供了大规模几何验证的监督数据。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes CNCGEN, a dataset and learning framework formulated around persistent manufacturing objects that couples discrete operation decisions with continuous toolpath generation conditioned on evolving stock states, providing ~50k geometrically verified synthetic machining flows and 800 real CNC records for three-axis machining.
